title: New Engineer Integrations — Weekly Check-in Bridge Notes
text:
New Engineer Integrations — Weekly Check-in Bridge Notes

Weekly bridge notes for new hires + integrations sprint (informal).

SUMMARY:
- Purpose: keep a tight loop between hiring, buddy pairs, and service owners for the first 30 days. This doc captures huddles, shadow schedule, access blockers, and quick interview follow-ups.
- Audience: platform-engineering leads, new hire buddies, hiring panel.

HIGHLIGHTS THIS WEEK (Mar 5–12):
- Jordan finished first end-to-end deploy shadow (kv-cache service). Observations: local infra differences caused a 20m setup delay — need a small script to sync envs (see action 1).
- Nora completed the infra onboarding checklist v0.3 and added docs for credential rotation flows.
- Ravi ran second round of pairing with SRE on tracing hooks; recommended we add a "first-fix" ticket template for new engineers.

CANDIDATE / NEW HIRE UPDATES:
- Jordan Kim (SWE I, started Mar 2)
  - Current: paired on kv-cache owner rotation, wrote a small fix in PR#679 (minor formatting + test).
  - Blockers: restricted GCP project access for load-test cluster (ENG-4827). Waiting on infra-iam to confirm.
  - Next: shadow on-call on Mar 15 (afternoon) with Liam.

- Maya Lopez (interview loop, offer stage) — quick debrief from panel (Mar 9)
  - Strengths: systems debugging, strong infra debugging story, good on latency tradeoffs.
  - Concerns: limited experience with TF-serving and quantized models (ok for platform hire, but ramp plan needed).
  - Decision: move to final hiring discussion; follow-up assignment: small design doc on routing policy for fallback variants. (Hiring owner: Nora)

BUDDY & SHADOWING SCHEDULE (bridge program):
- Week 0–1: env setup, 3x shadow sessions (2h each), readme + quick wins.
- Week 2: ownership of a small bug, 1 pairing PR, shadow on-call.
- Week 3–4: mini-project handed off by buddy, independent deploy with review.
- Current schedule (this doc week): Jordan: Mon/Wed shadow kv-cache (2h), Fri pairing on metrics ingest (3h).

OBSERVED TEAM HEALTH SIGNALS (pulse):
- Bandwidth: 6/10 (spikes this week due to infra incident prep).
- Clarity of ramping tasks: 8/10 (checklist helped).
- Buddy availability: 7/10 (some delays from SRE).
- Comments: folks appreciate the shadow matrix but want shorter setup steps.

SETUP / ACCESS / TOOLING BLOCKERS:
- ENG-4827: GCP test cluster access (affects Jordan's load tests). Owner: infra-iam. ETA: Mar 14.
- Local dev image mismatch: documented in confluence, but needs a script to align base packages. Action: Jordan + Liam to produce sync script by Mar 18.
- CI flakiness on macOS runners for PRs with native builds — workaround added, long-term fix tracked in PR#701.

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due):
- Action 1: Create env-sync script for dev images (Jordan, Liam) — due 2026-03-18.
- Action 2: Hiring follow-up for Maya: assign take-home design doc + rubric (Nora) — due 2026-03-16.
- Action 3: Escalate ENG-4827 if infra-iam doesn't respond by Mar 14 (Aisha) — due 2026-03-14.
- Action 4: Add "first-fix" ticket template to our issue templates for ramp pairing (Ravi) — due 2026-03-20.
- Action 5: Shorten onboarding README to a 10-minute quickstart (owner: Platform Docs) — suggested owner: Eli (notes captured in Confluence).

MEETING NOTES / HIGHLANDERS (raw fragments from 2026-03-11 huddle):
- "Need to reduce the number of credentials steps — one place to request dev creds." — Nora
- "Pairing on the deploy path showed we have three undocumented assumptions about traffic shaping" — Ravi
- "Good to have Jordan run the soak test; he spotted a memory leak pattern." — Liam

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Does hiring allocate budget for a specialist on TF-serving/quantized models if we hire candidates without that background? (People ops + Eng leadership to confirm)
- How long do we keep a "buddy" assigned? Current plan: 60 days, but some suggestions to extend for infra-heavy hires.
- Should we formalize the bridge program into a 1-pager and include in job offers?

NOTES FOR NEXT WEEK:
- Quick 15m sync on Mon to check ENG-4827 status.
- Shadow handoff checklist to be validated by Jordan on Mar 19.
- If Maya accepts: plan first-week 1:1s and assign a short onboarding project aligned to Optimize tooling.

REFERENCES & LINKS:
- Onboarding bridge plan (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ONBOARDING-bridge-plan
- Ticket: ENG-4827 (GCP access)
- PR#679 (Jordan's first PR)
- Slack channel: #onboarding for quick q's

NOTES TO SELF (informal):
- Keep this doc terse; move more granular checklists into Confluence.
- Capture time spent by buddies this quarter; we may need headcount credit for high-touch hires.
- Consider a 1-hour "ramp retro" at day 30 for each new hire to capture improvements.

----
End of weekly bridge/health notes.
